newsitem.title: USA: Search halted for Italian missing off Florida.
newsitem.headline: Search halted for Italian missing off Florida.

text.p: The United States Coast Guard on Thursday said it had called off its search for an Italian tourist who vanished last weekend in an apparent boating accident in waters off the Florida Keys.
Davide Malloni, 25, whose hometown was not known, rented an 18-foot (6.3-meter) powerboat on Sunday for a fishing trip and was due back that evening, a Coast Guard spokeswoman said.

A Coast Guard aircraft spotted the overturned boat in the Florida Straits off Matecumbe Key on Monday but Malloni was not found. Officials said they believed he died in a boating accident, noting that the weather had been bad in the area.

Investigators said there was a chance Malloni might have survived and they had obtained photographs from his family to circulate on shore in case anyone had seen him. The Coast Guard said its aircraft and boat crews had searched a wide area for Malloni before giving up the search.
